title: Fortune 500 HQ States (Part 1)
blurb: Twenty-five Fortune 500 companies, two minutes, every state on the map. A company appears and you click the state where it keeps its headquarters. The right state scores 100, so a perfect round is 2,500. Part 1 of 20: all 500 companies on the 2026 Fortune 500, shuffled across the set. For exact cities, play the HQ Hunt.
